description: Get a specific price by ID, including amount, currency, and billing interval. Every record is annotated with `effective_unit_price` (cents actually charged per unit) and `effective_unit_price_note`. READ THAT, not `unit_price`: on a tiered scheme (volume/graduated) `unit_price` is vestigial and is NOT the charged amount -- the real per-unit price lives in `tiers[]`, and such records also carry `unit_price_is_not_charged: true`. On `package` pricing `unit_price` IS charged, but it buys a block of `package_size` units, so `effective_unit_price` reports the per-unit figure and the record carries `unit_price_is_per_package: true`.
name: ls_get_price
